description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingModifyCommandResponse' that extends other interfaces and provides a method to set Ditto headers, serving as a response type for modify commands on 'Thing' models within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing a response to a modify command on a 'Thing', extending base command response and including optional entity handling.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for this response, returning the response type for chaining.
